subject: Literature
title: Hamlet and the Tortured Mind
description: Learn Hamlet and the Tortured Mind in one minute.

hook.text: A prince learns his uncle murdered his father, but instead of acting, he spends the entire play thinking.

buildup.text: Hamlet stages a play-within-a-play to test his uncle's guilt, inventing psychological manipulation on stage.

discovery.text: The 'To be or not to be' soliloquy became the most famous speech in English literature, debating existence itself.

twist.text: Hamlet's overthinking leads to the death of nearly every major character, including himself.

climax.text: Shakespeare created the first literary character who feels like a real, conflicted modern human being.

punchline.text: Literature's greatest hero was paralyzed by thought.

quiz.question: What makes Hamlet revolutionary as a literary character?
options: He is the strongest warrior in Shakespeare's plays
He is the first character who feels like a real, conflicted modern person
He is the only Shakespearean character who survives
